page.notes: The line after the last text line ("u" mid-line and a mark at the left, "nec" at the right) is treated as the catchword "nec"; the stray "u" and the left mark were not included. The running head is partly illegible; only "LECTA" is clear. Marginal marks at the right edge are ink spots or stray marks, not printed notes. The ligature for "ct" is written as "ct". Some abbreviations (q;, &, ā, ē, ī) are transcribed as printed; "argumētum" and "appellātur" keep their macron abbreviations.
